title: Invoices, receipts and tax endpoints
goal: Let owners, admins and billing members list a workspace's invoices and get receipt/tax information, from a local mirror of Stripe invoices that is cheap to page and safe to expose.
scope_in: `GET /v1/workspaces/{id}/invoices` with CT-PAGE cursor pagination (`limit` 1..200 default 50, newest first), scope `billing:read`.
Local `invoices` mirror table with money as integer minor units + ISO-4217 (USD/EUR), tax amount, tax rate summary, status, period, and links to the Stripe-hosted invoice and PDF.
`applyInvoiceEvent(stripeInvoice)` entry point for the Stripe webhook handler (B072) plus lazy refresh `syncInvoices(workspaceId)` when the mirror is older than 5 min.
Mapping layer from Stripe invoice objects to the public invoice shape; unknown statuses map to `other`.
Authorization via the RBAC engine permission for viewing invoices; audit of reads is NOT required, audit of nothing is written (read-only endpoint).
scope_out: Creating checkout or portal sessions (B071); tax-ID and billing-address editing happens in the Stripe customer portal.
Verifying and ingesting Stripe webhooks (B072); this lane only provides the function it calls.
Generating PDFs; Stripe-hosted documents are linked, never proxied or stored.
build_against: Use recorded Stripe invoice JSON fixtures (test mode) stored under the lane's test directory and a Stripe API stub (`nock`-style HTTP interception through the provider abstraction from B070). No live Stripe account is needed.
interfaces: `type Invoice = {id: string; number: string|null; status: 'draft'|'open'|'paid'|'void'|'uncollectible'|'other'; amount: {amount:number; currency:'USD'|'EUR'}; tax: {amount:number; currency:'USD'|'EUR'}|null; period_start: string; period_end: string; created_at: string; paid_at: string|null; hosted_url: string|null; pdf_url: string|null}` (provisional, see notes).
`applyInvoiceEvent(inv: StripeInvoiceLike): Promise<void>` and `syncInvoices(workspaceId: string): Promise<{upserted: number}>`.
Table `invoices(id, workspace_id, stripe_invoice_id UNIQUE, status, amount_minor, tax_minor, currency, period_start, period_end, created_at, paid_at, hosted_url, pdf_url, updated_at)`.
acceptance: A caller with role owner, admin or billing receives 200 with a page of invoices ordered by `created_at` desc, then id desc; a `member` or `guest` receives 403 `forbidden`.

`limit=2` over 5 invoices returns 2 items, `has_more:true` and a `next_cursor` that, followed, returns the next 2 and finally 1 with `has_more:false`; a cursor reused with a different filter or older than 24 h returns 400-class problem+json.
Amounts are integers in minor units and currency is `USD` or `EUR`; an invoice in another currency is excluded and counted in metric `invoices_unsupported_currency_total`.
Calling `applyInvoiceEvent` twice with the same invoice (or out of order, older `updated`) leaves the row unchanged on the second call and never regresses `paid` to `open`.
A user from workspace A requesting workspace B's invoices gets 404/403 and no row data; response never contains card details, Stripe customer ids or payment-intent ids.
p95 latency of the list endpoint is <= 80 ms with 1 000 invoices in the workspace (mirror hit, no Stripe call).
When the mirror is older than 5 min, one lazy sync runs (single-flight per workspace) and Stripe is called at most once per workspace per 5 min under 20 concurrent requests.
tests: unit: Stripe-to-public mapping for all invoice statuses incl. unknown, tax present/absent, EUR and USD, zero-total invoices.
integration: pagination with cursor stability under concurrent inserts.
authz matrix test over all five workspace roles and cross-workspace access.
failure-path: Stripe 429/5xx during lazy sync returns the stale mirror with 200 and logs a warning.
contract: response headers include `RateLimit-*` and `X-Request-Id`; errors are problem+json.
guardrails: MUST NOT return or log Stripe customer ids, payment method details, or raw Stripe objects.
MUST enforce workspace scoping in the SQL `WHERE workspace_id = $1` of every query, in addition to the RBAC check.
MUST use `hosted_url`/`pdf_url` only as opaque links; never fetch them server-side (no SSRF surface).
MUST NOT block the response on Stripe availability; stale-but-correct mirror data is served when Stripe fails.
failure_modes: Stripe unreachable during lazy sync -> serve mirror, add no error to the response, record metric `invoice_sync_failed_total`.
Invoice references an unknown workspace (customer mapping missing) -> drop with error log and DLQ for B072, never create a row.
Cursor invalid or expired -> 400 problem+json per CT-PAGE.
